data.name: aws-face-recognition-autoscaler
data.title: Queue-driven autoscaler for an inference API
data.description: An async image-inference service whose controller scales workers out with the queue backlog and back to zero. A from-scratch redesign of my CSE 546 project that fixes the race that sent results to the wrong requests.
highlights: 100/100 results matched to the right request under 25 concurrent clients; the course version got at most 19/100 right
Scales 0 → 5 workers under load and back to 0 about 3 s after it ends
24 tests, including AWS (SQS, S3, DynamoDB, EC2) against moto; CI on Python 3.11 to 3.13

data.name: HabitNest
data.title: Habit tracker with real-time multi-device sync
data.description: A daily habit tracker with streaks and a 7-day history. Sign in with Google or email to sync across devices in real time, offline included, or use it as a guest.
highlights: Field-level Firestore writes, so edits from different devices merge instead of overwriting each other
Security rules plus multi-device sync covered by 21 tests on the Firestore emulator, run in CI
Drag to reorder with mouse, touch or keyboard; deployed by GitHub Actions on every push

data.name: real-time-iot-data-streaming
data.title: Real-time IoT streaming pipeline
data.description: Simulated Apple Watch telemetry streamed through Kafka into Cassandra, served over a Flask REST API and visualised in a live Dash dashboard.
highlights: Kafka producer and consumer group writing six time-series Cassandra tables
Twelve REST endpoints feeding a dashboard that refreshes every minute
Whole stack runs locally with Docker Compose

data.name: twitter-elasticsearch
data.description: Tweet search and sentiment pipeline: collects tweets from the Twitter API v2, scores sentiment with TextBlob, indexes them in Elasticsearch for full-text search and serves results and Plotly charts from Flask.

data.name: edge-cloud-face-recognition
data.description: Two-stage face recognition: MTCNN detection at the edge on AWS IoT Greengrass, recognition on AWS Lambda, decoupled with SQS. 100/100 correct at about 0.78 s average latency.

data.name: ML-model-deployment-using-Flask-and-GCP
data.description: A scikit-learn salary-prediction model taken from training to a hosted web service with Flask, gunicorn and Google App Engine.

data.name: Face-recognition-model-GCP
data.description: Face identification with OpenFace embeddings and a Keras classifier, aligned with dlib and served through a Flask upload-and-predict app.
